en-US.shortDesc: PS1/PSX-era horror art direction combining low-poly affine textures, limited color depth, fog, and psychological horror staging for Blender assets.

zh-CN.shortDesc: PS1/PSX 时代恐怖美术指导，将低多边形仿射纹理、有限色深、雾效与心理恐怖调度用于 Blender 资产。

en-US.shortDesc: Production QA gate for Blender assets using viewport screenshots, validation checklists, naming audits, and ship/no-ship verdicts via MCP.

en-US.shortDesc: Photorealistic AAA art direction for Blender including photogrammetry cleanup, real-world scale, high-poly workflows, PBR accuracy, and scan optimization. Use for cinematic and AAA game realism.

en-US.shortDesc: Blender rendering with Cycles and Eevee including sampling, denoising, camera setup, render passes, color management, and render optimization. Use for final output and look validation via MCP.

en-US.shortDesc: Retro 16-bit art direction for Blender-assisted SNES/Genesis-era color richness, dither cues, and sprite-like clarity.

en-US.shortDesc: Retro 8-bit art direction for Blender-assisted pixel/low-res aesthetics inspired by NES-era constraints.

zh-CN.shortDesc: Blender 辅助的复古 8 位美术指导，面向受红白机时代约束启发的像素/低分辨率美学。

en-US.shortDesc: Production rigging in Blender with armatures, IK/FK, constraints, weight painting, mechanical rigs, facial rigs, and drivers. Use before animation on deforming assets via MCP.

en-US.shortDesc: Large scene layout in Blender with collections, linking, overrides, streaming-friendly organization, and set assembly via MCP.

en-US.shortDesc: Blender sculpting for organic and hard surface detail using Dyntopo, multiresolution, brushes, alpha workflow, wrinkles, and damage. Use when high-frequency surface detail is needed before retopology in Blender via MCP.
